personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with 6 Glass / Luxe structure
personality_one_liner: A premium, map-first PropTech platform combining data-driven market intelligence with generous whitespace and confident typography.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Pad map interfaces so elements float cleanly above tiles. Cards have inner md/lg padding.

do's: Use heavy blur (expo-blur) for the Map screen's top search bar and filter chips.
Use frosted glass overlay for floating property map pins (price indicators).
Use blur on the bottom tab bar specifically when Map content scrolls underneath it.
dont's: Do not blur standard list rows in the Explore tab.
Do not use glass for text inputs or primary CTAs.

screens.name: Map
screens.purpose: Primary discovery interface displaying react-native-maps with OpenStreetMap tiles, floating price pins, and swipeable bottom property cards.

states.loading: Map skeleton with subtle pulse, skeleton chips in header.
states.empty: No properties found in this area. Prompt user to zoom out or reset filters.
states.error: Failed to load map data. Show retry button floating over map tiles.

screens.layout: Full-screen map. Top: Glassmorphism search bar & horizontal scrollable filter chips (Buy, Rent, Plots, Price). Bottom: @gorhom/bottom-sheet showing swipeable horizontal cards of properties in the viewport, hovering above the bottom tab bar.

screens.name: Explore
screens.purpose: Curated feed of localities, trending properties, and market insights.

states.error: Unable to load market trends. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Standard vertical ScrollView. Header contains Profile avatar. Sections include 'Featured Localities' (horizontal cards with skyline imagery) and 'Market Intelligence' (list rows).

screens.name: Property Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific listing, featuring the InfraValue vs DLC comparison and rich imagery.
screens.layout: Hero image gallery (expo-image pager) with gradient scrim at bottom. Big price number (Space Grotesk) and address. Below: Grid of stats (Beds, Baths, SqYd). A dedicated 'InfraValue vs Govt DLC' card showing estimated market range visually. Sticky primary CTA 'Contact Agent' / 'Compare' at the bottom.

screens.name: Locality Intelligence
screens.purpose: Data-rich page for a specific Jaipur area (e.g., Jagatpura), showing price graphs and infrastructure news.
screens.layout: Hero image of Locality skyline. Metric cards (Avg Price/Sq Yd, YoY Growth). Price history line chart. Vertical timeline for 'Infrastructure Projects' (e.g., Metro expansion, Ring Road). Small 'Hyperlocal News' feed section.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Frictionless entry collecting mobile number, name, and target area without OTP.
screens.layout: Minimalist centered form on Ivory background. Big bold typography 'Welcome to InfraLocal'. Floating label text inputs for Name, Mobile Number, and Area dropdown. Sticky bottom CTA 'Start Exploring'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the premium Ivory (#FFFFF0) base with Deep Navy (#0A192F) and Terracotta (#C25934) accents. The color scheme is the foundation of the 'premium minimal' ask.
Use react-native-maps with OpenStreetMap tiles. Implement custom marker views using glassmorphism for price pins.
For the bottom sheet property cards on the Map screen, use @gorhom/bottom-sheet. Ensure cards are horizontal and swipeable (Carousel or horizontal ScrollView).
Format all prices correctly using Indian numbering systems (e.g., ₹35 Lakh, ₹1.25 Cr) and use the Space Grotesk font for these large data points to emphasize the 'intelligence' aspect.
Maintain maximum 4 tabs (Map, Explore, News, Saved) as instructed by standard guidelines, placing the user Profile accessible via the header on the Explore tab.
Do not use gradients or gaudy graphic vectors. Stick to the curated real photos provided and use solid or subtle glassmorphism surfaces.
